availability.note: Available in every App Store and Play country, including territories Apple or Google add later.

en-US.description:
Vorinthex AI is your personal AI.

You know it's somewhere: an idea, a photo, a video, or a document. Finding it again shouldn't be the hard part.

Keep your files in Storage, your own secure cloud space. Notes, documents, photos, audio, videos, and Core chats stay together as the story of your work, instead of feeling scattered.

Core doesn't have to start from zero. Ask in your own words. It can use the content you've chosen to keep in your current scope to find answers and make connections.

Create images, speech, or short videos with Core. What you make is saved with the rest of your work. Chats live in Storage too, with transcripts you can find again and bring into a new conversation.

One private space. One personal AI. Sparks are one balance for Storage and Core.
en-US.promotionalText: Keep your work. Ask Core. Your personal AI that starts from your context.

review.notes: Sign in with Apple or Google to create a reviewer account. There is no username or password. Use Sign in with Apple.
